verdict_scope: kernel replay cannot preserve same-allocation CPU/GPU coexecution contract
reason: GPU system atomics and CPU atomics modify the SAME managed/UnifiedMemory allocation while the device launch is outstanding. Device-only replay does not repeat host participation for every metric pass. Restoring GPU-visible state is insufficient to reconstruct CPU/device interleavings; even successful process exit is not unchanged coexecution.
requirements: Do not use current multi-pass kernel replay for this contract. Separate reviewed application replay must reproduce fresh CPU execution, managed allocation and property checks each pass; kernel matching/determinism and output isolation must be reviewed. Single-pass collection is a separately declared diagnostic, not automatic approval.
instrumentation_alternative: Application replay with fresh per-pass output roots; or instrument one real execution with a separately approved single-pass metric set. Keep property rather than raw atomic outcome identity.

verdict_scope: static host-participation criterion only; full device memory checkpoint/restore and scientific audit required
reason: All six work arrays are cudaMalloc device buffers. CPU synchronisation-flag readback and prefix sum occur BETWEEN kernel launches using blocking cudaMemcpy; no selected kernel waits for a concurrently executing host response. Phase2 convergence changes successive kernel input states, so its first invocation is only one convergence state.
requirements: Require complete restoration of device-written sync_points/sizes/flags/output for each metric pass, unchanged callback stream ordering, successful final exact decode and scratch/guard CPU audits, and no profiler warnings. Source review does not prove inter-block convergence under every instrumented schedule. Inventory every phase and convergence-state role before ROI aggregation.
instrumentation_alternative: Application replay if checkpoint/restore or instrumented convergence fails, preserving original loop and full audits; NVTX stages/explicit reviewed invocation selectors for phase coverage. Never replace adaptive host convergence by fixed iteration count.

verdict_scope: individual independent encoding kernels only; serialized profile is not concurrent pipeline performance
reason: Four streams operate on disjoint 768-byte input/1024-byte output slices; pinned host input remains stable until each stream completes. No CPU worker must respond during kernel execution. Device input/output state is replayable, but serialization and cold caches remove the intended overlap.
requirements: Keep each stream offset/padding case, all stream completions and full Base64 output checks. Require device-memory restore and no warnings. Do not infer concurrent four-stream throughput, transfer overlap, or whole ROI roofline from serialized first-per-geometry kernel counters.
instrumentation_alternative: For overlap-sensitive questions use reviewed application/range replay supported by installed NCU, or separate CUDA timeline instrumentation. Application replay alone can still serialize selected launches; verify tool behavior rather than assume concurrency preservation.
